note: Costa Rica: the listed nationals enter without a visa for 180 days or 30; everyone else needs a consular visa, or one approved by the Commission for Restricted Visas (Afghanistan, Cuba, Haiti, Jamaica and others), which the game doesn't tell apart. A 30-day entry on a valid Canadian, Schengen or US multiple-entry visa isn't modelled. Read first from Wikipedia's copy, and on 2026-11-03 from the Dirección General de Migración y Extranjería's directives in La Gaceta (Alcance 148 of 17 November 2025), which confirmed every group but Barbados', moved to the first group (180 days), and gave the Northern Mariana Islands the second group's 30 days apart from the United States, so both were changed and Wikipedia's copy was no longer cited. Second-group stays extendable to 90 days aren't modelled.
